title: Leading an International Team
story: Ayesha Rahman is a senior project manager at the Dhaka office of a logistics software company. She works with Daniel, the product director in London, Mei, the finance lead in Singapore, and Tariq, a senior developer in Dhaka. Together they are delivering a tracking platform for a large shipping client, and the project is running behind schedule.
storyBn: আয়েশা রহমান একটি লজিস্টিকস সফটওয়্যার কোম্পানির ঢাকা অফিসের সিনিয়র প্রজেক্ট ম্যানেজার। তিনি লন্ডনের প্রোডাক্ট ডিরেক্টর ড্যানিয়েল, সিঙ্গাপুরের ফাইন্যান্স লিড মেই এবং ঢাকার সিনিয়র ডেভেলপার তারিকের সাথে কাজ করেন। তাঁরা মিলে একটি বড় শিপিং ক্লায়েন্টের জন্য ট্র্যাকিং প্ল্যাটফর্ম তৈরি করছেন, কিন্তু প্রকল্পটি নির্ধারিত সময়ের চেয়ে পিছিয়ে আছে।

units.focus: Describe ongoing work and long-running problems
units.focusBn: দীর্ঘ সময় ধরে চলমান কাজ ও সমস্যার বর্ণনা দেওয়া

sessions.tipBn: অতীতে শুরু হয়ে এখনও চলছে এমন কাজের সময়কাল বোঝাতে has/have been + verb-ing এবং for/since ব্যবহার হয়।

items.en: Ayesha has been leading the Dhaka team since the project kicked off in January.
Daniel and Mei have been negotiating the new contract terms with the client for almost three weeks.
Our developers have been working overtime to make up for the delays in the testing phase.
The client has been asking for weekly progress reports ever since the first deadline slipped.
Tariq has been mentoring two junior developers alongside his regular workload this quarter.
I've been meaning to schedule a call with you to discuss the revised budget.

sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক করতে has বা have-এর পরে not বসে, তারপর been + verb-ing।

items.en: The server hasn't been performing well since we migrated the data last month.
We haven't been receiving timely feedback from the client's legal team lately.
Mei hasn't been sleeping much because the budget review has been keeping her busy.
Honestly, the team hasn't been communicating as openly as it did at the start.
I haven't been ignoring your emails; I've simply been traveling for the client workshops.
Daniel hasn't been attending the daily stand-ups because of the time difference.

sessions.tipBn: প্রশ্ন করতে Has বা Have শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject, been ও verb-ing।

items.en: Have you been tracking the hours your team spends on change requests?
Has the client been complaining about the slow loading times on the dashboard again?
Have Tariq and his team been testing the new release over the weekend?
Has Mei been working on the cost forecast for the next quarter?
Have you been feeling overwhelmed by the number of meetings lately?
Has the London office been using the new approval workflow since March?

sessions.pattern: How long / What / Why / Who + has/have + subject + been + verb-ing?
sessions.tipBn: How long দিয়ে সময়কাল, আর What, Why, Who দিয়ে চলমান কাজের ধরন বা কারণ জানা যায়।

items.en: How long have you been managing projects with teams in different time zones?
Why has the client been delaying the sign-off on the final design?
What has Tariq been doing to reduce the number of bugs in each release?
Who has been handling the vendor invoices while Mei is on leave?
How much time have we been losing because of unclear requirements?
Which issues have you been raising in the weekly stakeholder meetings?

sessions.pattern: A workplace update written mostly in the present perfect continuous.
sessions.tipBn: দীর্ঘদিন ধরে চলা কাজ, সমস্যা বা প্রচেষ্টার বর্ণনায় has/have been + verb-ing বারবার আসে।

items.title: An honest timeline update
items.en: Dear all, I want to give you an honest picture of where we stand. The team has been working extra hours for the past three weeks, but we have been struggling with unstable test servers. As a result, we have been running about ten days behind schedule. Tariq has been coordinating with the IT team to fix the environment, and I will share a revised timeline on Monday.

items.title: Performance review notes
items.en: Tariq, over the past year you have been doing excellent work on the tracking module. You have been mentoring two junior developers, and their code quality has improved a lot. However, you have been taking on too many tasks at once, and some deadlines have slipped. Next quarter, I would like you to delegate more and focus on the architecture.

items.title: Working across time zones
items.en: The Dhaka team has been staying online until nine at night for months to join calls with London, and it has been exhausting. Mei has been working late in Singapore to overlap with both offices. We have been experimenting with shorter meetings and more written updates. So far, the results have been encouraging, and people have been responding faster in the shared channel.

units.focus: Explain what had already happened before key project moments
units.focusBn: প্রকল্পের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মুহূর্তের আগে কী ঘটে গিয়েছিল তা ব্যাখ্যা করা

sessions.pattern: Subject + had + past participle + before/by the time/after ...
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের দুটি ঘটনার মধ্যে যেটি আগে ঘটেছিল, সেটি বোঝাতে had + past participle ব্যবহার হয়।

items.en: By the time Daniel joined the call, Ayesha had already walked the client through the new dashboard.
The client had signed the original contract before anyone noticed the missing clause.
Mei had prepared three budget scenarios before the finance committee met on Tuesday.
We realized that the vendor had shipped the wrong hardware only after the installation began.
Tariq had warned us about the database limits long before the system crashed.
After the team had reviewed all the feedback, Ayesha drafted a new project plan.

sessions.pattern: Subject + hadn't / had never + past participle ...
sessions.tipBn: না-বোধক করতে had-এর পরে not বা never বসে, তারপর past participle।

items.en: The client hadn't read the proposal before the meeting, so we had to explain everything again.
Ayesha hadn't expected the budget cuts until Mei showed her the latest figures.
We hadn't tested the backup system properly, which caused a long outage last Friday.
Daniel had never managed a fully remote team before he took on this project.
By the time we noticed the error, nobody had backed up the latest version.
Tariq hadn't received any clear requirements when he started building the module.

sessions.tipBn: Hadn't দিয়ে প্রশ্ন করলে বোঝায় আমরা ধরে নিয়েছিলাম কাজটি আগেই হয়ে গিয়েছিল।

items.en: Hadn't the client already approved the design before they asked for more changes?
Hadn't Tariq warned us about the database limits several months before the crash?
Hadn't Mei sent the revised forecast to the board before Thursday's meeting?
Hadn't we agreed on the scope before the client added three new features?
Hadn't Daniel already left the office by the time the client called back?
Hadn't you finished the handover notes before you went on leave?

sessions.tipBn: প্রথমে Wh-word, তারপর had, subject ও past participle বসে।

items.en: What had the vendor promised before they missed the delivery date?
How long had Ayesha been in the role before she was promoted?
Why hadn't anyone informed the client about the delay before the steering committee meeting?
Which tasks had the team completed by the end of the second sprint?
Who had approved the extra spending before Mei joined the company?
Where had the team stored the old files before the migration?

sessions.pattern: A short account that uses the past perfect for the earlier events.
sessions.tipBn: গল্পের মূল ঘটনা past simple-এ, আর তার আগে ঘটে যাওয়া ঘটনা had + past participle-এ লেখা হয়।

items.title: What went wrong in phase one
items.en: Looking back, the delay in phase one was not a surprise. The client had changed the requirements twice before we even finished the design. We had also underestimated the time needed to connect the old database. By the time we raised the issue with the stakeholders, we had already lost three weeks. Next time, we will flag risks much earlier.

items.title: The invoice problem
items.en: Hi Ayesha, I wanted to explain the invoice problem. Before I joined the finance team, the vendor had already sent two invoices with the wrong rates. My predecessor had paid the first one without checking it. When I found the error, the second payment had not gone out yet, so I stopped it. I have asked the vendor for a refund.

items.title: A difficult negotiation
items.en: The negotiation with the client was tense from the start. They had expected a discount because we had missed the first deadline. Before the meeting, Daniel and Mei had agreed on the lowest price they could accept. After both sides had presented their positions, Ayesha suggested a compromise: a small discount in exchange for a longer contract. By the end of the day, everyone had signed.

units.focus: Report decisions, processes and results formally
units.focusBn: সিদ্ধান্ত, প্রক্রিয়া ও ফলাফল আনুষ্ঠানিকভাবে জানানো

sessions.pattern: Subject + be (is/was/has been/will be/must be) + past participle (+ by ...).
sessions.tipBn: কে কাজটি করেছে তার চেয়ে কাজটি বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ হলে be + past participle দিয়ে কর্মবাচ্য তৈরি হয়।

items.en: The revised contract was signed by both parties on Thursday afternoon.
All expense claims must be submitted through the finance portal by the fifth of each month.
The server issue has been resolved, and all services have been restored.
The final report will be shared with the stakeholders by the end of the week.
Weekly progress reports are reviewed by the steering committee every Monday morning.
Tariq is being considered for a promotion after his outstanding work this year.

sessions.tipBn: কর্মবাচ্যের না-বোধক বাক্যে be-এর পরে not বসে, যেমন hasn't been paid, won't be announced।

items.en: The invoice hasn't been paid yet because the purchase order is missing.
Confidential client data must not be stored on personal laptops under any circumstances.
The new features weren't included in the original quote, so they will be charged separately.
Our request for extra staff was not approved by head office.
The meeting minutes haven't been circulated to the rest of the team.
The launch date won't be announced until the security audit is complete.

sessions.tipBn: কর্মবাচ্যে প্রশ্ন করতে is, was, has, will বা can শুরুতে বসে, তারপর subject ও past participle।

items.en: Has the updated timeline been approved by the client's project board yet?
Were the new team members given access to the shared drive on their first day?
Will the training sessions be recorded for colleagues in other time zones?
Is the budget reviewed every quarter or only at the end of the year?
Was the client informed about the delay before the contract was renewed?
Can these last-minute changes be made without affecting the launch date?

sessions.pattern: Could you tell me / Do you know / I was wondering + if/whether/wh-word + subject + passive verb ...
sessions.tipBn: ভদ্রভাবে জানতে Could you tell me বা I was wondering দিয়ে শুরু হয়, আর ভেতরের অংশে সাধারণ বাক্যের মতো subject আগে বসে।

items.en: Could you tell me when the final invoice will be sent to the client?
Do you know whether the new security policy has been approved yet?
I was wondering if the deadline could be extended by a few days.
Would you mind telling me why my leave request was rejected?
Could you find out how the extra project costs were calculated?
I'd like to know who will be assigned to the client account next year.

sessions.pattern: A formal workplace text that uses the passive in several tenses.
sessions.tipBn: আনুষ্ঠানিক প্রতিবেদন ও অনুরোধে কাজটির উপর জোর দিতে বিভিন্ন কালের কর্মবাচ্য ব্যবহার হয়।

items.title: Incident report
items.en: On Tuesday evening, the tracking platform was taken offline for almost two hours. The problem was caused by an expired security certificate. The issue was detected by our monitoring system, and a new certificate was installed within ninety minutes. No customer data was lost. To prevent this in the future, all certificates will now be checked automatically every week.

items.title: Formal request for resources
items.en: Dear Daniel, I am writing to request two additional testers for the next phase. As you know, the scope has been expanded significantly since the contract was signed. If the request is approved, the new testers will be trained in Dhaka during the first week. All costs have been reviewed by Mei and can be covered by the contingency budget. I would appreciate your decision by Friday.

items.title: Steering committee summary
items.en: Several important decisions were made at yesterday's steering committee meeting. The launch has been moved to the second week of November to allow more time for testing. The extra features requested by the client will be delivered in a separate phase and billed separately. Daniel was asked to update the risk register, and a revised plan is expected by next Wednesday.

units.focus: Reflect on past decisions and their results
units.focusBn: অতীতের সিদ্ধান্ত ও তার ফলাফল নিয়ে ভাবা

sessions.pattern: If + had + past participle, would have + past participle. / If + had + past participle, would + verb (now).
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের কাল্পনিক অবস্থায় If + had + past participle ও would have বসে; ফল বর্তমানে হলে would + verb বসে।

items.en: If we had hired more testers in March, we would have caught these bugs much earlier.
If the client had approved the budget on time, the platform would be live by now.
Ayesha would have flown to London for the workshop if her visa had arrived in time.
If Mei had missed the error in the invoice, we would have lost a lot of money.
If I had accepted the job in Singapore, I would be working with Mei every day now.
Had we known about the new regulations, we would have planned the rollout differently.

sessions.pattern: If + hadn't + past participle, wouldn't have + past participle / wouldn't + verb.
sessions.tipBn: hadn't, wouldn't have বা wouldn't দিয়ে অতীত বা বর্তমানের না-বোধক কাল্পনিক ফল বোঝানো হয়।

items.en: If Tariq hadn't stayed late on Friday, we wouldn't have met the release deadline.
We wouldn't be so far behind schedule if the requirements hadn't changed so often.
If Daniel had read the report carefully, he wouldn't have questioned our figures in front of the client.
The client wouldn't have renewed the contract if we hadn't fixed the outage so quickly.
If I hadn't taken on that difficult project last year, I wouldn't be a senior manager today.
Nobody would have noticed the mistake if the client hadn't asked for a detailed breakdown.

sessions.pattern: Wh-word + would + subject + have + past participle + if + had ...?
sessions.tipBn: Wh-প্রশ্নের পরে would have + past participle এবং If + had + past participle দিয়ে অতীতের কাল্পনিক অবস্থা জানতে চাওয়া হয়।

items.en: What would you have done differently if you had managed the first phase?
How would the client have reacted if we had missed the second deadline too?
Where would we be now if we hadn't moved the servers to the cloud?
Which vendor would you have chosen if cost hadn't been an issue?
Why would Mei have approved the extra spending if she had known about the audit?
How much money would we have saved if we had negotiated a fixed price?

sessions.pattern: A reflective text with third and mixed conditional sentences.
sessions.tipBn: অতীতের সিদ্ধান্ত নিয়ে ভাবতে third conditional, আর তার ফল এখন পর্যন্ত থাকলে mixed conditional ব্যবহার হয়।

items.title: Lessons from the project review
items.en: In our project review, we asked ourselves one honest question: what would have happened if we had acted sooner? If we had flagged the database risk in March, the client would have agreed to a later launch. If Daniel had joined the planning sessions, he would have understood the local challenges. And if we had built a stronger testing process from the start, we would not be fixing so many bugs today.

items.title: Thanks after the negotiation
items.en: Hi Mei, thanks for your support during the price negotiation. If you hadn't prepared those cost scenarios, we would have accepted a much lower offer. I also think we would have closed the deal faster if we had involved the legal team earlier. Had the client pushed harder, we might have lost the contract altogether. Let's discuss what we can learn from this next week.

items.title: A performance review conversation
items.en: During her review, Ayesha talked openly with Tariq about the past year. If he had asked for help earlier, some deadlines would not have slipped. Still, she pointed out that the team would be in a much weaker position today if he had not mentored the junior developers. If he had not handled the server crisis so calmly, the client might have walked away. She recommended him for a promotion.
